notes: Drona Parva, night of the fourteenth. Ghatotkacha is an adult rakshasa-kshatriya prince (heroic medium, Amar Chitra maharathi) — never a child, never a horror demon. No gore: gold Shakti-light, mountain-fall of light. Karna has already given away kavacha-kundala; he holds Vijaya and the one-use Vasavi dart. Krishna is the Ep 09 look lock (charioteer, not flute).

ghatotkacha.face: Adult rakshasa-kshatriya prince, broad noble face, dark mustache, fierce dark eyes — never a child, never a horror mask
ghatotkacha.hair: Dark hair, small gold diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown, not Krishna’s peacock)
ghatotkacha.costume: Storm-indigo and gold engraved armor, cream sash, mace — equal human scale, heroic medium fill, never flower garland, never saffron sage robes

karna.face: Adult king of Anga, proud mustache, sun-warmed skin, resolute eyes — distinct from Arjuna
karna.hair: Dark hair, jeweled Anga diadem (not Arjuna’s heavy crown, not peacock feather)
karna.costume: Deep gold and crimson engraved armor, Vijaya bow, the Vasavi dart as a gold spear of light — never flower garland, never Krishna pitambar, no divine kavacha

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava king, proud mustache, fierce gaze
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair under a jeweled Kuru crown
duryodhana.costume: Jewel-tone gold and saffron Kaurava armor, mace — field king, not a sage

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene, U-tilak — same face as Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold jewelry, charioteer reins — never a flute, never a bow

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09–12
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

armies.costume: Muted night banners, equal human scale, no gore
